t2.descripcion:
The DELE B2 listening comprehension test consists of 5 tasks and 30 questions. You have approximately 40 minutes. Key strategies:
• Before listening, read the questions and options to anticipate the topic.
• The first time you listen, focus on the general idea; the second time, on the details.
• Take quick notes of key words while listening.
• Pay attention to transition words (sin embargo, por lo tanto, etc.) that indicate contrast or consequence.
• Don't get stuck on a word; follow the thread of the conversation.
• In matching tasks, identify the differences between the options.
• At the end, check that you haven't left any question blank.

📌 IMPORTANT NOTE: Hispanic accents vary; get used to hearing Spanish from Spain and Latin America. The test includes different accents.

❌ COMMON MISTAKE: Chinese students often try to understand every word instead of grasping the overall meaning. Also, many don't practice listening to non-peninsular accents and get lost. Practice with audios from various countries.
ejemplos: Lee las opciones antes de escuchar para saber qué información necesitas.
La primera audición sirve para captar la idea general; la segunda, para los detalles.
Toma notas de nombres, fechas y números mientras escuchas.
Presta atención a las palabras que indican contraste, como 'pero' o 'sin embargo'.
Practica con audios de diferentes países hispanohablantes para acostumbrarte a los acentos.

t1.descripcion:
The DELE B2 reading comprehension test consists of 4 tasks and 36 questions. You have 70 minutes to complete it. Key strategies:
• Read the questions first, not the whole text. That way you'll know what information to look for.
• Identify key words in the questions and look for them in the text.
• Don't stop at unknown words; deduce their meaning from context.
• Manage your time: don't spend more than 15-20 minutes per task.
• In true/false questions, locate the evidence in the text before answering.
• For matching tasks, read all the options before deciding.
• Review your answers at the end, but don't change them without a clear reason.

📌 IMPORTANT NOTE: The reading test is the first of the exam. Stay calm and start with the task that seems easiest to you to gain confidence.

❌ COMMON MISTAKE: Many students read the text word by word and run out of time. Chinese speakers tend to mentally translate everything into Chinese, which slows down reading. Practice direct reading in Spanish and avoid literal translation.
ejemplos: Before reading the text, read the questions to know what to look for.
Don't worry about words you don't know; try to guess their meaning.
In true or false questions, find the exact sentence in the text that justifies your answer.
Divide the time: 15 minutes for task 1, 20 for task 2, etc.
If a question blocks you, move on to the next one and come back later.

t3.descripcion:
The DELE B2 written expression and interaction test consists of 2 tasks: a formal writing (letter, email, etc.) and an informal writing (article, blog, etc.). You have 80 minutes. Key strategies:
• Read the instructions carefully and plan your text before writing.
• Structure the text: introduction, development and conclusion.
• Use varied connectors (además, sin embargo, por lo tanto, en primer lugar).
• Use an appropriate register: formal for task 1, informal for task 2.
• Check grammar, spelling and punctuation at the end.
• Take care with presentation: margins, paragraphs and legible handwriting.
• Make sure you meet the required word count (150-180 words per task).

📌 IMPORTANT NOTE: Written expression assesses coherence, accuracy and lexical richness. Don't take risks with structures you don't master.

❌ COMMON ERROR: Chinese speakers tend to translate directly from Chinese, which produces unnatural sentences. In addition, some don't review and make basic agreement errors. Practise writing directly in Spanish and always review.
ejemplos: Antes de escribir, haz un esquema con las ideas principales.
Usa conectores como 'en primer lugar', 'además' y 'por último' para organizar el texto.
En la tarea formal, utiliza fórmulas de cortesía como 'Estimado señor'.
Revisa siempre la concordancia de género y número al final.
Practica escribiendo textos de 150-180 palabras y cronometra el tiempo.

t4.descripcion:
The DELE B2 oral test consists of 3 tasks: a presentation on a topic, a description of an image, and a dialogue with the examiner. You have 20 minutes of preparation and 20 minutes of examination. Key strategies:
• In the preparation, organize your ideas with an outline and practice quietly.
• During the presentation, use varied connectors and structures.
• Do not memorize a speech; improvise naturally.
• In the description of the image, describe what you see and speculate about what could be happening.
• In the dialogue, respond fluently and ask for clarification if necessary.
• Take care of pronunciation and intonation.
• Maintain eye contact with the examiner.

📌 IMPORTANT NOTE: Fluency is more important than grammatical perfection. It is normal to make mistakes; do not get stuck.

❌ COMMON ERROR: Chinese students often speak too slowly for fear of making mistakes. Practice speaking at a natural pace and avoid long pauses. Also, some are not used to interacting with the examiner and limit themselves to reciting.
ejemplos: During the preparation, make an outline with the main ideas and the examples you are going to use.
In the presentation, start with a clear introduction and end with a conclusion.
To describe the image, use expressions like 'parece que', 'probablemente', 'quizás'.
If you do not understand a question, ask the examiner to repeat it: '¿Podría repetir, por favor?'
Speak at a steady pace and avoid long pauses; if you need to think, use fillers like 'bueno' or 'pues'.
